nom: Caudalie Premier Cru The Rich Cream for Skin Barrier Refillable Jar - 50 mL

avis.titre: Very creamy, very high quality, very high price
avis.texte: Reviewing Caudalie Premier Cru The Rich Cream, Skin Barrier Repairing Rich Moisturizer with Ceramides, Refillable - 50 ml This is a very high quality cream. It has a hint of a lavender scent and smells very nice. I found that less is more when it comes to this product. It is a very thick cream and absorbs into the skin without leaving a greasy or sticky feeling. If you are looking for a very rich moisturizer, this is for you. For my skin, I found it to be a bit too thick. When I applied it, if I started getting hot or sweaty, my face would feel like it was suffocating under the face cream and it left me feeling very uncomfortable. I have no doubt that this cream works for wrinkles and fine lines as my eye area feels softer and more plump after using, however, I can’t get beyond the heavy suffocating feeling on my skin. I try to use just a little bit once a day because I do see the benefits of hydration from this product. I think that for my skin, I would prefer the Caudalie cream as opposed to the Caudalie rich cream. I think the rich cream is just too heavy of a product for me. I like the fact that you can purchase a refill for the jar and save a little money while also not adding more waste to our landfills. I do feel that this product is quite pricy even though the product will last for a while. Even though the quality is there, the cost is a little more that I want to spend.

As a perimenopausal woman embarking on HT and sensitive skin changes (eczema flares, dry skin and breakouts) I LOVE this product and am finishing my second jar. When I first tried it I did notice a few zits, but its truly rich and gives a feeling of "sealing" the skin. I treated the zits and used less product and only at night / after showers (I have to restrain myself from slathering I love it so much) and problem solved. My skin is more smooth, balanced, calm and I see noticeable effects on signs of aging that I have not seen with other products. Good luck!

This cream is truly a game changer! After using it for a week I can confidently say my dry skin is dry no more! I struggle with dryness during the winter months and this has helped tremendously. After applying at night, my skin still feels soft throughout the next day. The scent is light and fresh. It’s very mild but I really enjoyed it. If you don’t like scented products, it’s not noticeable once it’s on your skin for a few minutes. I love the innovative packaging and being able to buy just the insert. As someone who is trying to be more eco-friendly this a perfect solution to minimize waste. Also, you get to save some money in the process! TLDR: this cream is very moisturizing and made my skin feel incredibly soft. This scent is nice and the packaging is innovative! Definitely give it a try.

Wonderful moisturizer. Feels so luxurious going on. My skin drinks it up, no heavy layer leftover. Your skin has a silky soft texture after use. My face and neck definitely have seen a benefit from use. I also love the light scent.
A rich cream, but absorbs quickly. Pricey, but it is a quality cream.
I love this cream ! I had tried it before and it’s the only that works my dry skin. Very happy with my purchase
My favorite moisturizer!! As an acne prone girly, this never breaks me out and keeps me moisturized. It also has cleared up my husbands dry skin on his face, which is the only product to do so.
Good deal on the refill, slight fragrance, skin feels supple after. It’s not lightweight by any means though.

Excellent!! The people in France know what they’re doing! This cream is so lovely and so rich and hydrating and I’ve changed from Charlotte Tilbury to this morning and night! Hands-down, the best cream for mature skin! You don’t need a day cream and a night cream…ladies, simplify your life! Highly recommended!

avis.titre: Very good quality cream for nature skin, worth the money.
avis.texte: Excellent cream, that feels nice to use, works really well under make up or at night, doesn’t leave too much residue on skin, and appears to make my skin look less lined and more moisturised, this is my 4th purchase. I like both the cream, and the rich cream.

I have been using this cream for about 3 weeks and it has become my new favorite cream. I tend to have oily skin, so I usually don't go for thicker creams. This is the perfect cream for my skin. It isn't too thick or sticky feeling. My skin loves it and doesn't make my skin produce more oil. I haven't had any negative reactions to it. I have also recommended it to my friends & family.

avis.titre: Caudalie Premier Cru The Rich Cream
avis.texte: This facial cream feels absolutely luxurious from the first use. It’s perfect for repairing the escape area and targeting side of aging a little goes a long way. I only use a small amount on my face and neck and it looks as beautifully without feeling greasy. I have dry, sensitive skin and this cream leave it filling hydrated, smooth, and refresh. I also like that it comes in a refill bottle which fills both elegant and eco-friendly. My skin looks noticeably, healthier and more radiant with consistent use.
